SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE. S. B. REGISTRY. 29 Station Date 24 7 34）
S.2, Special Branch
Subject (in full) Movements of Mathias Zergel and Fania Karolich.
Made by D.S. Utkin Forwarded by D.S.U. D.I.
According to a verified information Mathias
Zergel, nick-name "Motka Barin", Russian Jew, age 72,
expert in ringing the changes, who was released from
the French Gaol on 15.7.34, is now residing in a Chinese
house at A-805 Broadway East. Zergel separated with
his wife and is now co-habiting with Fania Karolich,
Russian gipsy, age about 50, known shoplifter and formerly
a brothel-keeper at A-907 Broadway East. The latter
removed to the present address on 3.6.34 from 49 Range
Road.
O.A. (CB)
Information
HR
D.S. Utkin
D. S.
FILE
Officer i/c Special Branch.

主题（全称） 马蒂亚斯·泽格尔与法尼娅·卡罗利奇的行踪。
撰写人 D.S. 乌特金 转呈人 D.S.U. D.I.
根据经核实的情报，马蒂亚斯·泽格尔，绰号“莫特卡·巴林”，俄罗斯犹太人，72岁，调换诈骗专家，于1934年7月15日从法国监狱获释，现居住于百老汇路A-805号的一处华人房屋内。泽格尔已与妻子分居，现与法尼娅·卡罗利奇同居，后者为俄罗斯吉普赛人，约50岁，系知名的商店扒手，此前曾在百老汇路A-907号经营妓院。后者于1934年6月3日从兰格路49号搬至现址。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. L. a. D.: 9
Date: 23. 2. 29
13/2/29
Dear Mr Gilbert,
Many thanks for your
information. These two men are
always under the watch of the police.
One theory indicates that Horlonoff
is suspected of having committed or
participated in Arnold case and that
the money in the following may be the
proceeds of this robbery.
Will let you know any further
developments. Please keep these suggestions
Confidentially.
Yours faithfully
Stokes

29年2月13日
亲爱的吉尔伯特先生：
非常感谢您的
情报。这两个人一直
处于警方的监视之下。
有一种说法表明，霍洛诺夫
涉嫌犯下或参与了阿诺德案，且
下述款项可能是此次抢劫的
赃款。
如有进一步进展将通知您。请对这些建议
保密。
此致
敬礼
斯托克斯

(C.I.D.) Office Notes
January 19. 1928.

Sir,

At 6 p.m. January 18 while attending
with D.S. Duncan, the arrival of
the S.S. Sphinx at the China Merchants
lower wharf from Marseil,
I noticed Two Russian Shoplifters
Kinging - the changes experts arrived
by the said boat from South China
where they were undoubtedly operating
for some time. Their baggage was
searched by the Custom Authorities
but nothing incriminating was
found. They were, however, in
possession of a considerable
sum of money.
The following are the names of the
men in question.

(刑事情报处) 办公室笔记
1928年1月19日。

先生，

1月18日下午6时，在与
D.S. 邓肯一同出席
从马赛抵达招商局
下码头的“斯芬克斯”号轮船时，
我注意到两名俄罗斯商店扒手
即调换诈骗专家金（Kinging）
乘该船从华南抵达，
他们无疑在那里活动了
一段时间。他们的行李被
海关当局搜查，但未发现
任何罪证。然而，他们
持有相当数额的
现金。
